arxiv-2002-07597.title: Cahn-Hilliard model with Schlögl reactions: interplay of equilibrium and non-equilibrium phase transitions. I. Travelling wave solutions
arxiv-2002-07597.creator: P.O. Mchedlov-Petrosyan, L.N. Davydov
arxiv-2002-07597.description: Abstract The present work is devoted to the modelling which is based on the modified Cahn-Hilliard equation, the interplay of equilibrium and non-equilibrium phase transitions. The non-equilibrium phase transitions are modelled by the Schlögl reactions systems. We consider the advancing fronts which combine these both transitions.

arxiv-2207-10374.title: Thermal Transitions in Domain Wall AdS/QCD
arxiv-2207-10374.creator: Nick Evans, Jack Mitchell
arxiv-2207-10374.description: Abstract We study thermal transitions in a Domain Wall AdS/QCD model. The model is based on the D5/probe D7 system with a discontinuous mass profile which restricts chiral fermions to 3+1 dimensional domain walls. Fluctuations on the domain wall are dual to the quark mass and condensate and reveal the relation between domain wall separation and the quark mass.

Permission to make digital or hard copies of all or part of this work for perso
arxiv-2311-08850.creator: Róbert Belanec, Peter Lacko, Kristína Malinovská
arxiv-2311-08850.description: Abstract State-of-the-art generative models (e.g. StyleGAN3 [ 1 ] ) often generate photorealistic images based on vectors sampled from their latent space. However, the ability to control the output is limited. Here we present our novel method for latent vector shifting for controlled output image modification utilizing semantic features of the generated images.

arxiv-2312-00761.title: Deep Unlearning: Fast and Efficient Gradient-Free Class Forgetting
arxiv-2312-00761.creator: Sangamesh Kodge skodge@purdue.edu, Gobinda Saha gsaha@purdue.edu, Kaushik Roy kaushik@purdue.edu
arxiv-2312-00761.description: Abstract Machine unlearning is a prominent and challenging field, driven by regulatory demands for user data deletion and heightened privacy awareness. Existing approaches involve retraining model or multiple finetuning steps for each deletion request, often constrained by computational limits and restricted data access.

arxiv-2312-13448.title: Implied CO 2 {}_{\textbf{2}} -Price and Interest Rate of Carbon
arxiv-2312-13448.creator: Christian Fries
arxiv-2312-13448.description: Abstract By its nature, the so-called social cost of carbon (SCC(t)) will likely not cover the cost induced by climate change (damage cost and abatement cost) if it is used as a CO 2 -price. It is a marginal price only. We define an implied CO 2 -price that covers the climate change-induced costs.

arxiv-2502-00290.title: Estimating LLM Uncertainty with Evidence
arxiv-2502-00290.creator: Huan Ma, Jingdong Chen, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Guangyu Wang, Changqing Zhang
arxiv-2502-00290.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Huan Ma, Jingdong Chen, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Guangyu Wang, Changqing Zhang. Over the past few years, Large Language Models (LLMs) have developed rapidly and are widely applied in various domains. However, LLMs face the issue of hallucinations, generating responses that may be unreliable when the models lack relevant knowledge. To be aware of potential hallucinations, uncertainty estimation methods have been introduced, and most of them have confirmed that reliability lies in critical tokens.

arxiv-2601-01666.title: More About the Spontaneous Breaking of Time Reversal in de Sitter Space
arxiv-2601-01666.creator: Leonard Susskind
arxiv-2601-01666.description: Abstract It is widely thought that the quantum theory of de Sitter space requires the existence of a physical observer in the static patch. What exactly is meant by an observer is unclear; it could be anything from a few photons with energy just above the Gibbons-Hawking temperature to a gravitationally bound cluster of galaxies.

pmc-12397272.description: China launched a major health-care reform in 2009 aimed to provide all citizens with equal access to basic health care with reasonable quality and financial risk protection. Since then, China has made substantial progress toward Universal Health Coverage (UHC). However, the access of UHC among internal migrants might be disadvantaged compared with local residents.

pmc-12624332.title: Expanding Chemistry of Expanded Helicenes
pmc-12624332.creator: Shinji Toyota
pmc-12624332.description: Expanded helicenes are interesting compounds created by modifying the original helicene structure through the incorporation of linearly fused benzene rings, enlarging the helical diameter. Motivated by Tilley et al.’s report of a key expanded helicene structure in 2017, several research groups have synthesized such nonplanar aromatic compounds, aiming to explore their impressive structures, properties, and chiroptical performance.

pmc-12644824.title: Permethrin induces epileptic susceptibility via activation of Na+ channels and rise in glutamate

pmc-12644824.description: Permethrin, a common pyrethroid insecticide, is extensively used to control insect pests and has been widely detected in the environment. A growing body of epidemiological studies has revealed a substantial increase in the prevalence of epilepsy among individuals highly exposed to pesticides. However, the mechanism of action of permethrin in epilepsy remains elusive.

pmc-13556917.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAntipsychotic monotherapy is the guideline-supported mainstay of treatment for schizophrenia.
